subject.title: fix(volcengine): idle-timeout stalled TTS response bodies

question: Should Volcengine TTS use the existing request `timeoutMs` unchanged as each response-body chunk's idle deadline, including for valid slow or buffered production streams?
rationale: The code mechanically applies a shared facility, but the acceptable tradeoff between preventing indefinite hangs and allowing long silent intervals from this provider is a runtime policy choice that mock coverage cannot establish.

options.title: Confirm request-timeout idle policy
options.body: Accept `timeoutMs` as the body idle deadline after a redacted real-provider trace shows normal synthesis does not encounter unsupported silent intervals.

options.title: Use a separate bounded body policy
options.body: Choose and document a Volcengine-specific body idle deadline if provider behavior requires a different threshold than the overall request timeout.

options.title: Pause pending provider evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open until a realistic endpoint or controlled proxy trace establishes the correct streaming behavior.

recommendation.title: Confirm request-timeout idle policy
recommendation.body: Accept `timeoutMs` as the body idle deadline after a redacted real-provider trace shows normal synthesis does not encounter unsupported silent intervals.
